name: rbxdev-ls
description: Full Roblox/Luau language support with type checking, completions, and Sunc API support

languageModelTools.name: rbxdev_get_bridge_status
languageModelTools.description: Get the current status of the Roblox executor bridge connection. Returns whether the bridge is running, connected, and the executor name if connected.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Check if the Roblox executor bridge is connected. ALWAYS call this first before using any other Roblox tools. If not connected, no other tools will work. Returns isRunning, isConnected, executorName, and the number of services in the game tree.

languageModelTools.name: rbxdev_execute_code
languageModelTools.description: Execute Luau code in the connected Roblox game. The code runs in the executor environment with access to the full Roblox API.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Execute Luau code in the connected Roblox game with full Roblox API access (game, workspace, Players, Instance.new, Vector3, CFrame, etc.). Use 'return <expr>' to get a value back. Write complete scripts in a single call rather than multiple calls. The code runs on the CLIENT side. If execution errors occur, read the error carefully and fix the code.

code.description: The Luau code to execute in the game

languageModelTools.name: rbxdev_get_game_tree
languageModelTools.description: Get the current game hierarchy tree from the connected Roblox game. Returns the structure of services and their children.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Get the game hierarchy tree showing all services and instances. IMPORTANT: Always explore the game tree before trying to interact with specific instances — don't guess at paths, look them up. Use the path parameter to drill into a specific subtree (e.g., ["Workspace"]). Use 'json' format when you need structured data for programmatic use. The tree only shows a few levels deep — use get_children for deeper exploration.

path.description: Optional path to a specific node (e.g., ["Workspace", "Folder"]). If omitted, returns all services.

format.description: Output format: 'tree' for human-readable, 'json' for structured data. Defaults to 'tree'.

languageModelTools.name: rbxdev_get_properties
languageModelTools.description: Get property values from an instance in the Roblox game.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read property values from any Roblox instance. ALWAYS read properties before modifying them with set_property — this tells you the current value and the correct valueType to use. Pass specific property names in the 'properties' array for faster results, or omit it to get all properties. Returns name, value, and valueType for each property.

properties.description: Optional list of specific property names to fetch

languageModelTools.name: rbxdev_set_property
languageModelTools.description: Set a property value on an instance in the Roblox game.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Set a property on a Roblox instance. You MUST specify the correct valueType. Common types: 'string', 'number', 'boolean', 'Vector3' (value: '1, 2, 3'), 'Color3' (value: '255, 0, 0' as RGB), 'CFrame' (value: '0, 5, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, 1'), 'UDim2' (value: '0, 100, 0, 50'), 'EnumItem' (value: 'Enum.Material.Neon'). Use get_properties first to check the current value and type.

property.description: Name of the property to set

value.description: The value to set (as string, e.g., '100', 'true', '1, 2, 3' for Vector3)

valueType.description: The type of the value (string, number, boolean, Vector3, Color3, CFrame, UDim2)

languageModelTools.name: rbxdev_teleport_player
languageModelTools.description: Teleport the local player to an instance's position in the Roblox game.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Teleport the local player to an instance's position. The target must be a BasePart or Model with a Position/CFrame. Use get_game_tree to find valid targets first.

languageModelTools.name: rbxdev_delete_instance
languageModelTools.description: Delete an instance from the Roblox game. This is permanent and cannot be undone.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Permanently delete an instance from the game. WARNING: This cannot be undone. Always confirm with the user before deleting. Verify the path is correct using get_game_tree first.

path.description: Path to the instance to delete (e.g., ["Workspace", "Part"])

languageModelTools.name: rbxdev_reparent_instance
languageModelTools.description: Move an instance to a new parent in the Roblox game hierarchy.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Move an instance to a new parent in the game hierarchy. sourcePath is the instance to move, targetPath is its new parent. Both paths must exist — verify with get_game_tree first.

sourcePath.description: Path to the instance to move

targetPath.description: Path to the new parent instance

languageModelTools.name: rbxdev_get_children
languageModelTools.description: Get the children of an instance in the Roblox game.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Get the direct children of an instance. Use this to explore deeper into the game tree when get_game_tree doesn't show enough depth. Essential for navigating large hierarchies like PlayerGui, StarterGui, or deeply nested models.

format.description: Output format: 'tree' for human-readable, 'json' for structured data

languageModelTools.name: rbxdev_get_script_source
languageModelTools.description: Get the decompiled source code of a Script, LocalScript, or ModuleScript in the Roblox game.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Decompile and read the source code of a Script, LocalScript, or ModuleScript. Useful for understanding game logic, debugging, or reverse engineering. Find script paths using get_game_tree first — scripts show as Script/LocalScript/ModuleScript class names in the tree.

languageModelTools.name: rbxdev_create_instance
languageModelTools.description: Create a new instance in the Roblox game as a child of the specified parent.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Create a new Roblox instance as a child of the specified parent. Common classes: 'Part', 'MeshPart', 'Model', 'Folder', 'Script', 'LocalScript', 'ModuleScript', 'ScreenGui', 'Frame', 'TextLabel', 'TextButton'. After creating, use set_property to configure its properties (Size, Position, Color, etc.).

className.description: The Roblox class name to create (e.g., 'Part', 'Folder', 'Model')

name.description: Optional name for the new instance

languageModelTools.name: rbxdev_clone_instance
languageModelTools.description: Clone an existing instance in the Roblox game.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Clone (duplicate) an instance including all its children and properties. The clone is created as a sibling of the original. Useful for duplicating parts, models, or UI elements. Use reparent_instance after to move the clone elsewhere if needed.

path.description: Path to the instance to clone (e.g., ["Workspace", "Part"])

languageModelTools.name: rbxdev_get_remote_calls
languageModelTools.description: Get recently captured remote calls from the Remote Spy feature.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Get recently captured RemoteEvent:FireServer and RemoteFunction:InvokeServer calls. IMPORTANT: Remote Spy must be enabled first (use the 'Enable Remote Spy' command or execute code to enable it). Returns the remote name, type, method, and reproducible Luau code for each call. Useful for reverse engineering client-server communication and understanding game mechanics.

limit.description: Maximum number of calls to return (default 50)

languageModelTools.name: rbxdev_set_remote_spy_block_list
languageModelTools.description: Set the list of remotes to block from firing to the server.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Block specific remotes from firing to the server. Each block entry matches either by 'path' (e.g., 'ReplicatedStorage.Events.ChatEvent') or 'name' (e.g., 'ChatEvent'). Blocked remotes are intercepted and prevented from reaching the server.

languageModelTools.name: rbxdev_save_instance
languageModelTools.description: Save the game or a specific instance to a file using saveinstance().
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Save the Roblox game (full DataModel) or a specific instance to a .rbxl/.rbxm file. The file saves to the executor's workspace directory on disk. Use path to target a specific instance, or omit to save the entire game.

rbxdev-ls.enableSuncApi.description: Enable Sunc executor API completions and type checking

rbxdev-ls.executorBridge.port.description: WebSocket port for executor bridge connections

rbxdev-ls.mcp.enabled.description: Enable MCP server for AI assistants (GitHub Copilot, Claude, etc.)

rbxdev-ls.bundler.path.description: Custom path to luau-bundle executable. Leave empty to auto-download.

rbxdev-ls.saveInstance.noscripts.description: Exclude all scripts when saving instances

rbxdev-ls.saveInstance.excludeServices.description: Services to exclude from full game saves
